scoring_justification: The headline results are the best-fit parameters from Table I; recomputing them from raw data would require re-executing the full scanning least-squares fit, which is infeasible in the lightweight verifier sandbox. Therefore the checker compares the submitted parameters to the paper-reported gold values with absolute tolerances that account for digitisation and fitting spread.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden gold parameter values for Mn2+ and Cr3+ from Table I
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table I: Values of the Parameters in Eq. [2] for Mn2+ A vs T curve and Cr3+ D vs T curve in MgO
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's Table I, with tolerances set to 2× the reported absolute errors to absorb digitisation and fitting variations.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual published results from the source paper, traceable to Table I. The tolerances match the stated measurement uncertainties expanded modestly.

outputs.description: Best-fit parameters of the single-mode empirical model (Eq. 2) for Mn2+ and Cr3+ in MgO. Values must match the reported results in Table I within tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares each parameter against the paper's gold values using absolute tolerances. Digitization uncertainty is absorbed by the tolerances.

steps.description: Compare the 10 best-fit parameters against paper-reported gold values with absolute tolerances.
